jobs.description:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

Our client is a full-service advertising, digital media, and AI-forward marketing agency serving local, regional, government, education, and public-sector clients. The agency is expanding its organic-search capabilities and developing a modern SEO offering that combines traditional search strategy with Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).




ROLE OVERVIEW

The SEO & GEO Specialist will develop and manage organic-search strategies for the agency and its clients, combining traditional SEO practices with emerging GEO and AEO approaches. The role will focus on improving discoverability across traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences through technical SEO, content strategy, local SEO, analytics, and reporting.

This is a strategic, hands-on role responsible for identifying organic-growth opportunities, implementing SEO improvements, testing emerging search practices, and helping develop a scalable SEO + GEO service offering for the agency.




LOCATION

Fully Remote | 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST | 20 hours a week| Part-time




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


SEO STRATEGY & ORGANIC GROWTH

 - Conduct comprehensive SEO audits covering technical SEO, on-page optimization, content, website structure, local search, and organic performance.

 - Develop client-specific SEO roadmaps based on business objectives, current performance, competition, and audience search behavior.

 - Conduct keyword research, search-intent analysis, competitive analysis, and topic research.

 - Identify high-impact organic-growth opportunities and prioritize recommendations based on expected business impact.

 - Establish measurable SEO goals and KPIs for assigned client accounts.
 
 


ON-PAGE SEO & CONTENT STRATEGY

 - Optimize existing website content, including page titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal links, image attributes, and page structure.

 - Identify content gaps and recommend blogs, landing pages, FAQs, resource pages, service pages, and other search-driven content.

 - Develop SEO and GEO content briefs for writers, social media teams, creative teams, and web partners.

 - Create keyword maps, topic clusters, and content strategies aligned with audience questions and search intent.

 - Ensure website content supports organic visibility and a clear, useful user experience.
 
 


TECHNICAL & LOCAL SEO

 - Identify technical SEO issues involving crawling, indexing, redirects, broken links, duplicate content, canonical tags, sitemaps, robots directives, page speed, and mobile usability.

 - Review website architecture and provide clear technical recommendations to developers and web partners.

 - Identify opportunities to implement schema markup and structured data.

 - Manage or support local SEO initiatives, including Google Business Profile optimization, local keyword strategies, location-based content, and citation consistency.

 - Monitor Google Search Console and other SEO tools to identify technical issues and optimization opportunities.
 
 


GEO & AEO STRATEGY

 - Research how clients, brands, services, and competitors appear across AI-powered search and answer experiences.

 - Identify high-value questions and natural-language queries used across search engines, voice assistants, and AI platforms.

 - Develop content and information-architecture recommendations that improve clarity, entity signals, topical authority, and machine understanding.

 - Identify opportunities for FAQs, question-based content, structured information, reputable third-party mentions, citations, and digital authority-building.

 - Monitor emerging GEO, AEO, and AI-search practices, tools, and measurement approaches.

 - Test practical GEO and AEO strategies, document findings, and distinguish meaningful opportunities from unsupported claims.
 
 


ANALYTICS, REPORTING & CLIENT COLLABORATION

 - Monitor performance through Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, keyword rankings, traffic, conversions, impressions, clicks, engagement, and agreed-upon KPIs.

 - Prepare monthly SEO reports explaining performance changes, their significance, and recommended next steps.

 - Present SEO findings and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.

 - Collaborate with social media, content, creative, production, paid media, and web teams to align SEO insights with broader marketing initiatives.
 
 


AI, AUTOMATION & SERVICE DEVELOPMENT

 - Identify repetitive SEO, reporting, research, and auditing tasks that could benefit from AI-assisted workflows and automation.

 - Develop reusable processes for SEO research, reporting, content planning, and audits.

 - Help refine and package the agency's SEO + GEO service offering for current and future clients.

 - Stay informed about evolving search behavior, AI tools, and organic-discovery trends.
 
 


QUALIFICATIONS


EXPERIENCE

 - 2–3 years of hands-on SEO experience, ideally within an agency or multi-client environment.

 - Experience managing SEO strategies across technical SEO, on-page optimization, content planning, analytics, and reporting.

 - Experience managing multiple client accounts and priorities.

 - Experience with AEO, AI workflows, automation, and service development are nice-to-haves.
 
 


SKILLS

 - Strong working knowledge of Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Google Business Profile, and comparable SEO platforms.

 - Experience working with WordPress or other content management systems.

 - Ability to identify technical SEO issues and provide actionable recommendations to developers and web partners.

 - Strong keyword research, search-intent analysis, content strategy, and competitive research skills.

 - Ability to analyze organic-search performance and translate findings into prioritized recommendations.

 - Experience with Looker Studio or similar reporting platforms.

 - Ability to create clear SEO reports and explain complex search findings to clients and internal stakeholders.

 - Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple client accounts and competing priorities.

 - Ability to test emerging search approaches, document results, and identify practical optimization opportunities.
 
 


PREFERRED SKILLS

 - Familiarity with schema markup and structured data.

 - Familiarity with AI-assisted research.

 - Knowledge of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

 - Knowledge of Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).

 - Familiarity with AI-search visibility and emerging organic-discovery practices.
 
 


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Clients have clear, prioritized SEO and GEO roadmaps aligned with meaningful business outcomes.

 - Technical SEO, content, local-search, and authority-building opportunities are consistently identified and addressed.

 - SEO reporting provides clients and internal teams with clear visibility into performance and recommended next steps.

 - SEO insights contribute to stronger content, social media, web, and broader campaign strategies.

 - The agency develops a practical, differentiated SEO + GEO offering that can scale across its client base.
 
 


OPPORTUNITY

The SEO & GEO Specialist will have the opportunity to help shape the future of organic search within a growing AI-forward agency, combining established SEO fundamentals with emerging GEO and AEO practices while developing a scalable service offering across a diverse client base.

 


APPLICATION PROCESS:


TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE THESE STEPS NEED TO BE FOLLOWED:

 - Fill in the application form

 - Record a video showcasing your skill sets

Adapt, a Welo Global brand, is an international digital performance marketing agency focused on driving the success of digital content across platforms and markets. In return, we offer the opportunity to develop your ability and exposure to a wide range of clients from growth-minded startups all the way up to global enterprise clients. Our client base is predominantly focused on B2B businesses, though we do also support customers in the e-commerce and retail space. Regardless of vertical, Adapt offers dynamic and diverse challenges that foster creativity, innovation and application of knowledge to create client solutions.


MAIN PURPOSE OF THE JOB
We are seeking a freelance Danish SEO Specialist to join and support our SEO team. In this role, you will play a key part in enhancing our SEO efforts by conducting keyword research, utilizing keyword planners, and optimizing content, among other responsibilities.

- Keyword Research

jobs.title: Senior SEO Strategist
jobs.description:
What makes a great company? Is it the products it produces, its reputation, or its culture? At Victorious, we know it’s our people. 



Our people-first ethos permeates every aspect of our company — from practicing radical integrity to empowering each other to do our best work. This approach attracts the sharpest minds in the industry and creates a culture that places empathy and kindness squarely in the middle of our commitment to rigorous methodologies. Working with us, you will gain exposure to and knowledge of a wide variety of industries. 



Our Strategists have a pivotal role in every aspect of our customers’ SEO strategy, from large-scale technical audits to helping define their first keyword strategy. At Victorious, you will have the opportunity to touch every aspect of SEO in an ever-changing technical landscape.



*Please note that we cannot sponsor visas. We thank you all for your interest, but we can only consider applicants who are authorized to work for an employer in the United States.



The ask: 

Drive and refine high-impact SEO strategies for assigned accounts, acting as the primary point of contact for their SEO services at Victorious. 

 

The expectation:

 - Execute SEO strategies for Victorious customers, proactively driving performance and making day-to-day decisions related to the execution of SEO services.

 - Identify and address issues related to SEO performance, technical challenges, implementation issues, or other potential obstacles to campaign performance.

 - Drive SEO innovation, identifying opportunities for service enhancements and new service offerings and staying ahead of industry trends to improve our company’s effectiveness across its customer campaigns.

 - Continuously monitor, evaluate, and enhance the quality of deliverables and contribute to team growth by spotting training needs during quality assurance processes.

 - Work cross-functionally with the content, web, and account management departments to ensure that Victorious campaigns are on pace and on track and delivered with collaboration for the best search-first campaign results.

 - Provide SEO expertise and guidance when consulted by SEO team members or cross-functional partners.

 - Stay up-to-date on the latest SEO strategies and trends, sharing knowledge with the SEO department and using insights to improve service deliverables.

 

Qualifications: 

 - Robust experience in search engine optimization

 - 7+ years working for a digital marketing agency in an SEO strategy role.

 - Ability to translate complex concepts into actionable insights and next steps

 - Experience working with SEO tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, etc.)

 - Advanced experience in Asana or related project management tools

 - Excellent organizational and time-management skills

 - Ability to adapt to new technology and tools and comfort in an agile, fast-paced remote environment

 - Understanding of HTML/CSS and website administration

 

You will love working here and thrive if…:

 - You are self-motivated. You don’t need to be tightly managed to be successful, yet you understand the importance of following processes and communication. You don’t need to be fired up; you’re self-motivated by an inner drive to produce the best results and to be part of creating something great.

 - You give a sh*t about your work. You believe in the inherent value of work and your role in helping a team succeed. You hate cynicism and are always looking to become a better version of yourself. Ego isn’t an issue for you because you know feedback is the fastest way to improve.

 - You demonstrate radical integrity. You take your responsibilities seriously, even if they’re difficult or uncomfortable. You do what you say you’ll do, and you’re always honest. Coworkers can rely on you to deliver, and management never worries about your work ethic.

 

Along with an amazing place to work, we offer:

 - Excellent Medical / Dental / Vision / Life / LTD Insurance

 - 401(k)/Roth Retirement Plan & Company Match

 - 100% Remote Work Environment

 - Unlimited Paid Time Off

 - Company-Paid Holidays + Wellness Days

 - Company-provided work equipment

 - Monthly Remote Work Stipend

 

A little bit about us:

From enterprise SEO efforts to boosting visibility for small businesses, Victorious is committed to helping marketers meet potential customers where they are — in organic search.

We check our egos at the door and draw on our wealth of knowledge to make impactful recommendations that help our customers shine in search. Our commitment to best practices goes hand-in-hand with our commitment to transparency.

At the end of the day, one core belief informs everything we do: If we stay true to the best interests of our customers and our team, we will all succeed — together.

To learn more about us, please visit our website at victorious.com http://victoriousseo.com/
